name: worktree-branch-naming
description: Customize the git branch name Claude Code gives new worktrees instead of the default worktree-<name> pattern.

branch_template.title: Branch name template
branch_template.description: Template for the git branch name created for each new worktree. Use {name} as a placeholder for the worktree's slug. Example: "claude/{name}" turns the name "issue-32-fix-xxxx" into the branch "claude/issue-32-fix-xxxx" instead of the default "worktree-issue-32-fix-xxxx".

base_ref.title: Base ref
base_ref.description: Which commit new worktree branches start from, mirroring Claude Code's built-in worktree.baseRef setting. "fresh" branches from the remote's default branch; "head" branches from the current local HEAD.
